_meta.description: Press-your-luck trivia for iPhone & iPad: win the trivia race, then flip cards to bank points, but don't draw a Zap. Duel friends on Game Center or in iMessage. 27 categories, 5,000+ questions, in 9 languages.
a-trivia-question-with.fbb2a9: A trivia question with four answers and a countdown timer
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
both-players-get-the.bfbe6c: Both players get the same question on the same clock. Answer first and answer right, and the draw is yours.
branding-by-marty-buck.24746a: Branding by Marty Buck · Sound design & original inspiration by Austin Buck · Development & music by Blaine Miller
correct-answers-earn-points.a4fb6f: Correct answers earn points based on the question's difficulty plus a speed bonus that decays as the clock runs. Answer instantly for the full bonus; wrong or timed-out answers score zero.
do-i-need-to.5d98a2: Do I need to be online?
every-duel-comes-down.5fb93f: Every duel comes down to speed, smarts, and nerve.
flip-cards-from-a.77e7d5: Flip cards from a shared 3×3 grid to bank 1, 2 or 3 points, then lock your pot or push on. Two Zaps hide in the grid, and one wipes the round.
from-science-and-history.6bd6d1: From science and history to anime, the Bible and six sports. New questions arrive over the air, with no update to install.
is-zap-available-in.3c30da: Is Zap available in the European Union?
nine-english-german-spanish.2d1223: Nine: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese. The questions are translated too, in the same order with the same answers, so mixed-language duels stay fair.
no-tracking-no-ads.9ce4d2: No tracking. No ads. No in-app purchases.
no-zap-ships-with.b21075: No. Zap ships with a full offline question set, so Solo and Pass N' Play work anywhere. Online and iMessage duels need a connection, and new questions download in the background when you're online.
nothing-zap-is-free.62ba3a: Nothing. Zap is free, with no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases.
pass-the-phone-across.1cc669: Pass the phone across the couch, take turns in iMessage, or play live and turn-based matches on Game Center.
race-to-answer-press.122a8c: Race to Answer. Press Your Luck.
some-trivia-questions-provided.7e3357: Some trivia questions provided by the Open Trivia Database, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
the-category-picker-with.1218d6: The category picker, with the question count for each category
the-press-your-luck.69fdcb: The press-your-luck card grid with the round pot and the Lock button
the-results-screen-crowning.303f8d: The results screen crowning the winner of a duel
the-zap-main-menu.a55b62: The Zap main menu with Solo Play, Pass N' Play and Play Online
trivia-meets-blackjack-win.a0093a: Trivia meets blackjack. Win the race to answer, then flip cards for points, but draw a Zap and you bust.
yes-both-players-receive.49ac22: Yes. Both players receive the exact same questions in the same order, derived from a shared random seed — neither side can see the other's questions in advance, and an anti-tamper check guards iMessage matches.
yes-zap-is-on.c4fb56: Yes. Zap is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
